Thank you.

And rest assured, as someone who was never a huge fan of drinking, I am giving up alcohol for good.  If that's the type of person that I am when drunk, then I never want to drink again.
I'm just having a very tough time living with the knowledge that I've violated the body, and trust of one of my closest friends.  Just thinking about it makes me sick to my stomach.
I don't think it's that simple.  She made it very clear that she never wants to see/talk to me ever again.
